hooks.name: Pre-Task Project Context
hooks.description: Injects project context and planning step before each spec task begins.

action.prompt:
A new task in the CamEventFlow spec is starting. Before writing any code:
1. Check which Day we are on in .kiro/specs/cameventflow.md (look at the unchecked items).
2. Review the relevant integration hole comments in the codebase if the task involves Mapbox, TalkJS, or Make.com.
3. Confirm you will follow all rules in .kiro/steering/project.md (Server Components by default, max-w-md mx-auto, auth pattern, pinned deps, no open hole removal).
4. State what files you plan to create or modify before proceeding.
